messages:
maria (Growth): Quick thought: ship a tiny local-reference app that doubles as a benchmark and a webinar demo. goal: community + early startups. short and practical.
ben (DevRel): sounds good. propose we include 3 bench scenarios: local docker, small dedicated, quantized cpu. record p50/p95 and token cost.
kai (Content): i'll write a step-by-step tutorial: clone -> run -> test prompts -> run-bench.sh. looking for a snappy refapp name.
cleo (Design): suggest "refkit-lite" or "seed-runner". i'll mock a hero + 10s GIF of the local run (800x420).
sophie (PM): timeline? want a pre-recorded 10m walkthrough + 30m live q&a. webinar date target: 05/20.
maria (Growth): timeline: draft by 05/02, design by 05/07, repo + bench scripts by 05/10, blog + GH release 05/12, webinar 05/20.
ben (DevRel): i'll add curl examples and a simple bench script. example command: `./run-bench.sh --scenario=docker --out=bench.json` and include expected numbers so folks can sanity-check.
kai (Content): messaging tests: email A/B "Local LLM dev in 10 minutes" vs "Ship LLM features faster". small seed lists.
cleo (Design): will prepare two hero variants for A/B. also inline GH README will need screenshots.
sophie (PM): inbound routing: CTA on blog to GH issue template + registration form. routing: GTM -> slack #sales-inbound via webhook.
maria (Growth): @ben add UTMs: `utm_source=refkitlite&utm_campaign=local-onboard`. we'll track conversions in GA and HubSpot.
ben (DevRel): done, i'll include UTM'd links in README and webinar emails.
kai (Content): will post draft docs in this thread by 05/02. please give quick feedback.
ops-bot: INC-4829 created: provisioning 2xA100 test slot for 48h for bench runs, ETA 10h.
cleo (Design): i'll upload Figma frames + GIF by 05/06.
maria (Growth): checklist: draft blog, GH refapp, bench script, hero + gif, webinar page, GTM+forms, email seed, announce channels (Discord, Hacker News, Twitter).
sophie (PM): owners: content=kai, devrel=ben, design=cleo, growth=maria, webinar ops=sophie.
maria (Growth): any blockers?
ben (DevRel): need small infra token to run quantized cpu tests. ops-bot please.
ops-bot: INC-4830 created: quantized-cpu slot scheduled, ETA 8h.
maria (Growth): nice. i'll book a 30m launch sync 05/08. thanks everyone. :rocket:
